firstPrint.basis: IRS publishes each tax-year-specific Table 3.3 workbook at a fixed, non-versioned {yy}in33ar.xls URL. Future first-print resolution must capture the workbook inside the registered release window; after that window it refuses. Late resolution would require a future adapter that authenticates release-time witnessed or versioned custody.

parseNotes: Workbook cell A2 states that all money amounts are in thousands of dollars.
Resolve from the Amount subcolumn adjacent to the admitted Number of returns column; never reuse the claimant count as dollars.
The requested usd_millions value is the printed integer multiplied by 0.001 with no additional rounding.
